models.name: U²-Net (small)
models.description: The 4.7 MB variant of U²-Net: a salient-object model that runs in a fraction of a second on a laptop CPU. Doory's default.

license.holder: U²-Net by Xuebin Qin, Zichen Zhang, Chenyang Huang, Masood Dehghan, Osmar R. Zaiane and Martin Jagersand (Pattern Recognition, 2020).
license.evidence: Verified 2026-10-04. The upstream repository https://github.com/xuebinqin/U-2-Net carries the Apache License 2.0 (LICENSE at commit ac7e1c817ecab7c7dff5ce6b1abba61cd213ff29), and its README distributes u2netp.pth (4.7 MB) as part of the project without any further terms; no non-commercial clause appears in the repository. The weights were trained on DUTS-TR only. The ONNX file is the export published by the rembg project (MIT) and is byte-identical to the Apache-2.0 mirror https://huggingface.co/BritishWerewolf/U-2-Netp (commit 7112208dbac3a3642496c8d54e2f0f9bb3dc1dc8), whose model card states that it is licensed under Apache-2.0 to match the original.

models.name: U²-Net
models.description: The full U²-Net (176 MB download, once per browser): somewhat more robust on busy scenes and fine detail. Install it with `sync_models --model u2net`; it is advertised in preference to the small model.
